# ZONES Four zones, set by the Commander. Changes are posted on the front page at any time. If a sign and a sentry disagree, the sentry is right.
## WHITE [color=#CFC7B8][bold]OPEN[/bold][/color] - Living blocks, the mess, shops, the clinic waiting room, the bar. - No checks. Patrols pass. Carry ID.
## YELLOW [color=#D9A441][bold]CONTROLLED[/bold][/color] - Landing pads, fuel, the power plant, atmosphere and water works, the comms relay, Colony Administration. - ID at the door. Bags searched. No loitering. No photographs.
## RED [color=#D23B3B][bold]CLOSED[/bold][/color] - Our compound, the armoury, the vehicle park, the command post and the fence line. - Escort and written pass only. Sentries will use force on intruders.
## BLACK [color=#FFFFFF][bold]NO ENTRY[/bold][/color] - Declared for gas, fire, cave-in, quarantine, unexploded charges or a fight. - Nobody crosses the cordon unless assigned to the response. Not you, not us.
## MARKINGS - Chevron striping on a barrier marks the edge of a zone. - Hazard striping marks a checkpoint lane. Stop at the painted bar. - Flashing amber lights on a cordon mean Black. Turn around.
The [netlink="Colony Herald" link="herald.colony.news"] may also carry zone changes. We do not answer its questions.
